briefdescription.para: A droppable user is a user for which uses can be dropped without affecting correctness and should be dropped rather than preventing a transformation from happening.

detaileddescription.para: This function is in charge of "letting go" of all objects that this User refers to. This allows one to 'delete' a whole class at a time, even though there may be circular references... First all references are dropped, and all use counts go to zero. Then everything is deleted for real. Note that no operations are valid on an object that has "dropped all references", except operator delete.

briefdescription.para: Replace uses of one Value with another.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces all references to the "From" definition with references to the "To" definition. Returns whether any uses were replaced.
